theories.name: Second night of a back-to-back
theories.desc: His team also played yesterday. Theory: tired legs, fewer threes.

theories.name: Hot hand
theories.desc: 45%+ from three over his last five games (10+ attempts). Theory: ride the streak.

theories.name: Cold hand
theories.desc: Under 25% from three over his last five games (10+ attempts). Theory: he is due.

theories.name: Next man up
theories.desc: One of his team's two biggest-minute players is not playing. Theory: the shots go somewhere.

theories.name: Blanked last game
theories.desc: No threes made last game (3+ attempts). Theory: he bounces back.

theories.name: Coming off a big night
theories.desc: Five or more threes made last game. Theory: it carries over.

theories.name: On the road
theories.desc: Away game. Theory: road shooters make fewer than projected.
